rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a deliberately rude remark or act aimed at humiliating someone.

example.english: Calling me useless in front of everyone is a real insult.
example.traditional: 你當住咁多人話我冇用，真係一種侮辱。
example.jyutping: nei5 dong1 zyu6 gam3 do1 jan4 waa6 ngo5 mou5 jung6 zan1 hai6 jat1 zung2 mou5 juk6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being rude or offending someone, especially when the insult may be unintended.

example.english: I didn't mean to insult you, so please don't take what I just said to heart.
example.traditional: 我唔係有心要得罪你，啱啱講嗰句你唔好介意。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 jau5 sam1 jiu3 dak1 zeoi6 nei5 ngaam1 ngaam1 gong2 go2 geoi3 nei5 m4 hou2 gaai3 ji3

rows.note: Use this when someone deliberately humiliates, degrades, or insults another person.

example.english: They did insult me in front of everyone, and I must seek justice.
example.traditional: 佢當住咁多人侮辱我，我一定要討返個公道。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dong1 zyu6 gam3 do1 jan4 mou5 juk6 ngo5 ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 tou2 faan2 go3 gung1 dou6

rows.note: Use this for a more formal or respectful description of affronting or offending someone.

example.english: If I insult you, please forgive me.
example.jyutping: jyu4 jau5 mou6 faan6 ging3 cing2 jyun4 loeng6

rows.note: Use this when the insult is framed as something offensive or unacceptable, such as a performance that offends the listener.

example.english: This film’s caricaturing of elderly people is an insult to the audience.
example.traditional: 呢套戲咁樣醜化老人家，對觀眾嚟講係一種冒犯。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 gam3 joeng2 cau2 faa3 lou5 jan4 gaa1 deoi3 gun1 zung3 lai4 gong2 hai6 jat1 zung2 mou6 faan6
